newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Quiet Friday follows Dow's slide.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Quiet Friday follows Dow's slide.

text.p: Stocks remained in line with closing prices in after-hours trade on Friday, quietly concluding a historic week that saw the Dow Jones Industrial Average shatter the 8000 milestone, traders said.
"It's Friday night and I think people are going home," a dealer said. He added that he had not seen any shares trade far off their closing prices.
During regular-hours trade, the Dow dropped 130 points to close unofficially at 7890.
"There's very little going on right now," another trader said, at the end of a week laden with earnings announcements.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume fell to 3,600, compared with 168,700 on Thursday. Session two volume was 4,091,9000. There was no session two volume reported on Thursday.
